description: Scan every map's events for Transfer Player commands and show how the maps are linked: each door with its destination, one-way links without a way back, transfers to maps that do not exist, and maps that cannot be reached from the game's start map. Transfers whose target is chosen by variables are listed as dynamic and cannot be followed, so 'unreachable' is a hint, not proof.

mapId.description: Only list doors on this map (the reachability analysis still uses all maps)

name: list_map_connections
title: List map connections
